nodes.description: Implement the approved Story, demonstrate RED/GREEN and simplify while green.
nodes.verify: Run related checks and record the changed files and evidence.

nodes.description: Review the final diff against the Story, including failure paths.
nodes.verify: Record findings and evidence; fail with the corrective action if changes are needed.

nodes.description: Run fresh verification after review fixes; prepare raw evidence for G4.
nodes.verify: Record actual commands, exit codes, changed-file scope and unproven boundaries.

output.summary: runCommand repeats the group SIGKILL every 20 ms after the first one, also after the result, until a kill fails or 250 tries; the timer stays ref d so a short caller cannot exit first. Cause of the team-gh flake: a child still being forked misses the one-shot group kill (macOS) and holds the pipes 5 s. Fork-race tests in a separate caller process failed first on bf3f31c, c6c67e4 and 6ab8aa2, then GREEN 6/6 x3; related files 337/337; typecheck exit 0 (c6c67e4, 6ab8aa2, a963036, 44a19b6).

Independent read-only reviewer, three passes: pass 1 With fixes (Important: re-kill stopped at close), pass 2 Ready (Minors: unref, vacuous tests, wall-clock cap), pass 3 With fixes (Important: unbounded test shell loop). Critical 0 throughout; every Important and Minor fixed; the pass-3 test-only fixes were verified by the implementer, not re-reviewed.

Fresh on 44a19b6 after all review fixes: full suite 1278/1278 exit 0 (116 s; both fork-race tests and the team-gh hang test pass inside it), typecheck exit 0, Story checker exit 0; scope src/runners/command.ts and tests/command.test.mjs. Not proven: that the one 5206 ms failure was this race (inferred), Linux, real CLIs stopped mid-fork, the other single-signal call sites, G4.

runCommand repeats the group SIGKILL every 20 ms until the group is empty (ESRCH) or the result is finished: a process still being forked when the one-shot kill landed escaped it (macOS) and held the pipes 5 s, the cause of the team-gh hang flake. New forking-shell test failed first 3/3 (CLI_CLOSE_UNCONFIRMED, ~5.1 s), then GREEN; related files 336/336; typecheck exit 0; original shape 22/2000 slow before, 0/10000 after.

history.reason: Review Important 1: the re-kill stops at close, so forked children that escaped the group kill without holding the pipes keep running
